heightMm.note: Exterior L x W x H (mm): '4635 x 1890 x 1605'.

kerbWeightKg.note: Kerb Weight (kg): '2020-2100'; lower bound used. GVW 2,540 kg.

availability.value: Sold new in Pakistan by Hyundai Nishat Motor in Smart (PKR 22,500,000) and Signature (PKR 24,999,000) trims, ex-factory.
availability.note: HNMPL price list (IONIQ 5: Smart 22,500,000; Signature 24,999,000). The model page https://hyundai-nishat.com/ioniq-5/ still shows 'From PKR 22,500,000'.

distributor.note: Price list footer: 'Hyundai Nishat Motor (Private) Limited, 1-B Aziz Avenue, Canal Bank Road, Gulberg V, Lahore'.

warranty.value: Vehicle: 4 years / 100,000 km. Battery: 4 years (Hyundai Nishat price list).
warranty.note: Footer badges: '4 YEAR 100,000 km Warranty Coverage' and '4 YEAR Battery Warranty'. No km limit printed on the battery badge.

batteryCapacity.note: Distributor spec: Battery Capacity (KWH) '84'. The DB's 72.6 kWh is the earlier/RWD global pack, not the AWD car Hyundai Nishat lists.

power.note: Distributor spec: Electric Motor Max. Power '239 (305)' kW (PS). DB 217 belongs to a single-motor variant. Figure is PS as printed.

range.note: Distributor spec: All-Electric-Range 'upto 500 km'. No test standard stated, so rangeStandard stays empty. DB 481 is a different variant's figure.

priceMin.note: Smart trim ex-factory PKR 22,500,000 (also 'From PKR 22,500,000' on hyundai-nishat.com/ioniq-5/). DB 17,000,000 was an indicative figure.

variant.note: Single trim; Product label 'Elantra Hybrid Blue' (also 'Hyundai ELANTRA Hybrid Blue' on the Aug 2026 price list).

warranty.value: Vehicle: 4 years / 100,000 km. Hybrid system: 8 years / 160,000 km (Hyundai Nishat price list).
warranty.note: Footer badges: '4 YEAR 100,000 km Warranty Coverage' and '8 YEAR 160,000 km Hybrid System'. Hyundai Nishat's conditions page (https://hyundai-nishat.com/conditions/) words it as hybrid components 4 years/100,000 km and high-voltage battery capacity 8 years/160,000 km.

heightMm.note: Kia Lucky Motor 'Sorento MY 26' spec sheet, 1.6T AWD PHEV column: Height (mm) 1,700. DB 1,695 came from PakWheels. Same sheet confirms 4,815 x 1,900, wheelbase 2,815, clearance 176, 13.8 kWh / 360 V, 47 L tank, 3.3 kW OBC, 15-95% in 3 h 25 min.

torque.note: Air column: Maximum Torque Front Motor '310 Nm', combined '160 kW / 310 Nm'. Earth is 230 kW / 480 Nm. Air used to match the row's headline 160 kW / 64.2 kWh / lower price.

acceleration.note: Air column: Acceleration (0-100 Kph) '8.5 Sec' (Earth 6.1 s). DB 8.4 does not match the distributor sheet; the DB notes already say 8.5 s.

warranty.value: Vehicle: 4 years / 100,000 km (Kia Lucky Motor EV5 spec sheet).
warranty.note: Cover page badge: '4 YEARS WARRANTY 100,000* KM'. No separate EV battery term printed. Replaces the DB's 'not publicly confirmed' text.

motorPowerKw.note: Performance > Electric Motor Power (kW): 53 for 1.8 HEV X and 1.8 HEV (motor torque 163 Nm; 2ZR-FXE engine 72 kW / 142 Nm). No combined torque is printed, so torque stays empty.

warranty.value: Vehicle: 3 years / 100,000 km built-in warranty (extendable to 5 years). Hybrid battery: 6 years / 160,000 km (Toyota Indus).
warranty.note: Corolla Cross page: 'Hybrid Battery warranty of 6 years or 160,000 KM (whichever comes first)'. Built-in warranty from https://toyota-indus.com/extended-warranty/: '3 years/100,000 KMs (whichever comes first) of built-in warranty', extension packages 'till 5 years'. Replaces the DB's unconfirmed '3–5 years' text.

groundClearanceMm.note: Nissan Japan spec sheet (June 2026), 主要諸元: 最低地上高 145 mm for S, X and G (marked as an in-house measurement). The same sheet gives X 1,070 kg, 47 kW / 195 Nm, 20 kWh, 350 V, WLTC 180 km, matching the DB.
